0022600120.text: The Cleveland Cavaliers (1-1, 9th in the East) host the Minnesota Timberwolves (3-0, 6th in the West) in this regular-season game, with Cleveland 3rd in the Central, 1.5 games back, and riding a W1 streak after a 1-0 home record. Minnesota arrives unbeaten on a three-game winning streak, going 2-0 on the road, and Donte DiVincenzo is out with an Achilles injury after surgery. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1, and Cleveland's most recent meeting was a 146-134 win in Cleveland on January 10, 2026.
